I can't verify the current rate. My last reliable figure is a target range of 3.50%-3.75%, set at the December 2025 FOMC meeting. The FOMC has met several times since then, including in September 2026, and my knowledge may not capture those decisions.

For the current number, check the FOMC statements at federalreserve.gov or the effective federal funds rate (EFFR) at newyorkfed.org. The EFFR typically sits a few basis points inside the target range.
